description:
Are you confused about when to use Git merge versus Git rebase? In this short, we break down the core differences so you can keep your commit history clean. Merge is great for bringing team branches together and preserving the exact story of how your code came together. Rebase is perfect for cleaning up a personal branch by building your work directly on top of the latest updates.
